title: Persistent unresolved issues and dealership stays
summary: This topic centers on unresolved or recurring issues, with several examples mentioning problems that remained, repeated operation troubles, or vehicles staying at the dealer, alongside a smaller set of comments saying the issue later cleared or did not recur.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe issues stopping after a repair or note that a comparable prior situation was not problematic.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on issues that persisted, happened repeatedly, affected features such as IPA, or were broad enough that owners felt there were too many problems to list.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews pair praise or resolution with the fact that the vehicle had earlier issues or that a problem seemed to clear up only after ongoing trouble.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention continued dealership time or ongoing payments without enough detail to tell whether the underlying experience was evaluated positively or negatively.

limitations: Examples are limited and often vague, using generic words like 'issue' without naming the affected system.
This cluster mixes several subjects, including recurring faults, dealership duration, feature operation, ordering/spec concerns, and comparison to prior vehicles.
Only a stratified sample of fragments is shown, so the examples may not capture all issue types within the topic.
Some positive examples are comparative statements about previous vehicles rather than clear resolutions for the reviewed vehicle.
